name: Inawashiro (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Inawashiro town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a small triangular notch.
history: Municipal flag of Inawashiro, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 12 December 1975.

features.role: Inawashiro town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a small triangular notch
